answer: Deposits are visible in spiral, and echo reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, someone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 127 aliases, and each one needs its own funded karst account. A bond of 24% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 19 times over for the same share of the pool. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
